gloss: the Edo shogunate; the Tokugawa shogunate

definitions.gloss: the Edo shogunate; the Tokugawa shogunate
definitions.explanation: The military government that {徳川家康|とくがわいえやす} founded in 1603, with its seat in Edo (now Tokyo). It ruled Japan until 1867; its time is the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {江戸幕府|えどばくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧。
examples.english: A shogun of the Edo shogunate.

examples.japanese: {江戸幕府|えどばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧260⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The Edo shogunate lasted about 260 years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{徳川家康|とくがわいえやす}→徳川家康：31006_tokugawaieyasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{江戸幕府|えどばくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1603⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It was in 1603 that Tokugawa Ieyasu founded the Edo shogunate.

notes:
WRITING:
- Also called {徳川幕府|とくがわばくふ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to found a shogunate
- {江戸幕府|えどばくふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: the Edo shogunate falls
- {江戸幕府|えどばくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{滅亡|めつぼう}→滅亡：13360_metsubou⟧: the fall of the Edo shogunate

CULTURAL NOTE:
- It was the last of three shogunates, after the ⟦{鎌倉幕府|かまくらばくふ}→鎌倉幕府：33136_kamakurabakufu⟧ and the ⟦{室町幕府|むろまちばくふ}→室町幕府：33137_muromachibakufu⟧. In 1867 the last shogun returned power to the emperor, which opened the way to the ⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧.
